description: This file defines a ShareDialog component for a collaborative drawing app, including UI elements for sharing links, starting/stopping collaboration, and copying links, with support for different platforms and internationalization.

methods.name: getShareIcon
methods.description: Determines the appropriate share icon based on the browser platform.

methods.name: ActiveRoomDialog
methods.description: Component for managing active room sharing, including copying and sharing links.

methods.name: ShareDialogPicker
methods.description: Component for selecting sharing options, including starting collaboration or copying links.

methods.name: ShareDialogInner
methods.description: Wrapper component that renders either ActiveRoomDialog or ShareDialogPicker based on state.

methods.name: ShareDialog
methods.description: Main exported component managing the visibility and rendering of the share dialog.
